record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical relativity
record.original_question: Can the space of globally hyperbolic vacuum Einstein metrics on V = R x M3 have more than one connected component, and what compactness or Palais-Smale-type condition for the mass function would be needed to analyze this question in the asymptotically flat setting?

evidence.quote: Can the . space of (globally hyperbolic, vacuum) Einstein metrics on V = RxM3 have more than one connected component? Gromov-Lawson [GL] have shown that the space of positive scalar curvature metrics on S7 does have more than one component (in fact, there are infinitely many components [CR]). It is known [CBM] that the mass function on 'f'JTI. (the set of maximal AF initial data sets satisfying the conditions of the positive mass theorem [BR6]) has only one smooth critical point, at R3. This suggests there is only one component in the space of AF spacetimes admitting a maximal Cauchy surface. What is needed here is some compactness/Palais-Smale condition for the mass function on 'U" 'JTI..

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M^3$ be a smooth, closed (or asymptotically flat) oriented 3-manifold and set $V = \mathbb{R} \times M^3$. Consider the space $\mathcal{E}(V)$ of smooth Lorentzian metrics $g$ on $V$ that (i) satisfy the vacuum Einstein equations $\mathrm{Ric}(g) = 0$, and (ii) are globally hyperbolic, i.e. $V$ admits a Cauchy hypersurface for $g$. Endow $\mathcal{E}(V)$ with a natural smooth topology (e.g. $C^\infty$-topology on metrics, modulo diffeomorphisms of $V$).

(a) Can $\mathcal{E}(V)$ have more than one connected component?

(b) Restrict attention to the asymptotically flat (AF) setting: let $\mathfrak{M}$ denote the space of maximal AF vacuum initial data sets $(M^3, g, K)$ satisfying the hypotheses of the positive mass theorem, and let $m : \mathfrak{M} \to [0, \infty)$ be the ADM mass functional. It is known that $m$ has a unique smooth critical point, namely flat Euclidean $\mathbb{R}^3$ with $K=0$. Formulate and establish a compactness or Palais–Smale–type condition for $m$ on $\mathfrak{M}$ sufficient to conclude that the space of asymptotically flat vacuum spacetimes admitting a maximal Cauchy surface is connected.
artifact.status_search_result: No source found establishing connectedness (or multiple components) for the space of globally hyperbolic vacuum Einstein metrics on $\mathbb{R}\times M^3$, nor a Palais–Smale condition for the ADM mass on the space of maximal AF initial data. The problem appears to remain open; related recent work (e.g., gluing of small black holes into initial data sets, large-data results for vacuum Einstein equations) addresses the structure of the initial data manifold but does not resolve the component count or the Palais–Smale question.

status_evidence.title: Gluing Small Black Holes into Initial Data Sets
status_evidence.snippet: Constructions of new vacuum initial data via gluing; addresses topology of the constraint manifold but does not resolve component count of vacuum Einstein metrics.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work studies the structure of vacuum initial data sets but does not establish or refute multiple components for the space of globally hyperbolic vacuum Einstein metrics.

status_evidence.title: A large data result for vacuum Einstein's equations
status_evidence.snippet: Large-data existence results for vacuum Einstein equations.
status_evidence.claim: Recent large-data results do not address connectedness of the space of vacuum Einstein metrics on R x M^3.
